# pii-redactor

> Detect and mask emails, phones, Luhn-valid cards, ISO 13616 IBANs and IPv4 addresses before text reaches an LLM, with reversible placeholders and a written threat model Python package `trysac-pii-redactor`, import name `pii_redactor`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
